```python
script = r'''
import sys
from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF
import email
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email import encoders
import base64

# --- Step 1: Read DOCX ---
doc = Document("testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# --- Step 2: Convert to PDF ---
pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)
pdf.add_page()

for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if not text:
        pdf.ln(4)
        continue

    style_name = para.style.name if para.style else ""

    if style_name.startswith("Heading 1") or (para.runs and para.runs[0].bold and len(text) > 20):
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 16)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1'))
        pdf.ln(3)
    elif style_name.startswith("Heading 2"):
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 13)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 7, text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1'))
        pdf.ln(2)
    elif style_name.startswith("Heading"):
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 11)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 6, text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1'))
        pdf.ln(2)
    else:
        # Check if paragraph has bold runs
        if para.runs and all(r.bold for r in para.runs if r.text.strip()):
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
        else:
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 5, text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1'))
        pdf.ln(1)

pdf_path = "testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf"
pdf.output(pdf_path)
print(f"PDF created: {pdf_path}")

# --- Step 3: Build .eml with PDF attachment ---
msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = "assistant@example.com"
msg["To"] = "bob@example.com"
msg["Subject"] = "Customer Report (PDF)"
msg["MIME-Version"] = "1.0"

body = MIMEText(
    "Hi Bob,\n\nPlease find the customer report attached as a PDF.\n\nBest regards",
    "plain",
    "utf-8"
)
msg.attach(body)

with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
    pdf_data = f.read()

attachment = MIMEBase("application", "pdf")
attachment.set_payload(pdf_data)
encoders.encode_base64(attachment)
attachment.add_header("Content-Disposition", "attachment", filename="customer_report.pdf")
msg.attach(attachment)

eml_path = "testbed/emails/bob/Customer Report.eml"
with open(eml_path, "w") as f:
    f.write(msg.as_string())

print(f"Email saved: {eml_path}")
print("Done!")
'''
await write_file("./convert_and_email.py", script)

result = await run_command("python ./convert_and_email.py")

print("PDF:", pdf_info)

eml_info = await get_file_info("testbed/emails/bob/Customer Report.eml")

```
